Sam (CS): Quick flag 30	Helios	30 ramped overnight, QBR forecast jumped ~33%. Can we triage before Friday?
Kai (FinOps): Looking. Do we know which endpoints? embeddings vs chat?
Rhea (Onboarding): Mostly embeddings. They kicked off a re-index job that re-embeds older docs every 10m.
Anton (Solutions): Also they recently toggled `high_precision=true` in the embed config. That ups compute heavily.
BudgetBot: :warning: Project HEL-99 at 79% of monthly credits.
Kai (FinOps): If unchecked additional monthly spend ~ $8.6k. Quick mitigations: 1) pause re-index, 2) flip `high_precision` off, 3) switch to quantized embed model. Which is fastest?
Rhea (Onboarding): Pause is immediate. Model flip is a config patch and quick. I'll pause the job now.
Sam (CS): I'll tell the account we're pausing the auto re-index and setting an ops call. Need a one-slide summary for QBR: impact, mitigations, ask (credits buffer or short Dedicated trial).
Anton (Solutions): Draft runbook snippet for engineers (paste to tech):
```
# pause job
POST /v1/projects/HEL-99/jobs/REINDEX/pause

# config patch: turn off high precision and switch model
PATCH /v1/projects/HEL-99/config
{ "embedding_config": { "high_precision": false, "model": "embed-compact-quant" } }

# soft quota via console or API
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/HEL-99/quota -d '{"soft_limit_pct":60, "hard_limit_pct":90}'
```
Kai (FinOps): I'll prepare slide numbers: estimated compute drop ~62% after model+cache; throttling adds another ~10-15%. Propose options: 14-day Dedicated micro pool OR 1-month 10% credits buffer tied to adoption checklist.
Rhea (Onboarding): Job paused at 08:07 PT. Requeues set to low concurrency.
BudgetBot: :white_check_mark: Incident HEL-cost-spike created and assigned to #customer-success.
Sam (CS): Action items: Kai finalize slide (ETA 90m), Anton add appendix metrics for QBR, Rhea keep job paused until sign-off, Sam draft customer note and schedule 30m ops call.
Kai (FinOps): Adding renewal-risk note: medium. I'll cc AMs.
Sam (CS): Great. We'll present the mitigation plus option for a Dedicated trial in the QBR and recommend follow-up enablement. Update thread when slide is uploaded. :thumbsup:
